patterns.note: Full-bleed black and white imagery serves as a backdrop for large, stark text overlays, creating a dramatic and immersive visual experience.

Extreme typographic scale contrast is used, featuring massive, wide sans-serif display headings that dominate sections, alongside a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
A strictly monochromatic palette of black, white, and subtle shades of grey is used throughout, emphasizing contrast and a sophisticated, editorial feel.
Text elements in the hero and footer sections exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than their background imagery as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
Content sections reveal themselves with a gentle slide-up or fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, guiding the user's attention through the page.
A prominent 'Selected Work' section is presented as a full-width, multi-column grid of black and white image cards, each with a title overlay.

technique_notes: The hero and footer sections utilize a parallax scrolling effect where large, overlaid text moves at a slower rate than the background image, creating a layered depth perception.
Content sections are introduced with a subtle animation, appearing to slide upwards or fade into view as they become visible within the user's viewport.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring persistent access to site links as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, wide, and bold sans-serif headings (~8x body) create a strong visual impact, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant throughout the design, with subtle rounding applied only to interactive elements like buttons and the circular footer CTA.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero and main content areas contributes to a sense of grandeur, while the 'Selected Work' grid maintains a balanced density for visual clarity.

standout: The site's distinctive design is characterized by its bold, almost brutalist use of typography, featuring massive, wide sans-serif text that frequently overlays full-bleed black and white imagery. This creates a powerful, editorial aesthetic reminiscent of a high-end magazine, further enhanced by subtle parallax effects.
